rule: δ-SNLI dev+test merged (line = 0-based line in data/defeasible-snli/<split>.jsonl). Drop rows with UpdateTypeImpossible==true; group remaining rows by exact (Premise, Hypothesis); keep pairs with >=1 strengthener and >=1 weakener. Cluster = image = SNLIPairId before '#'. Drop pairs whose image is among the snli images of read20_ids.json or the images of human20_images.json. Sort keys by (Premise, Hypothesis); rng = random.Random(20261070); rng.shuffle(keys); walk and keep a pair only if its image is not yet taken, until 150 pairs; first 30 = dev, next 120 = formal. In that order, for each pair rng.choice(S rows sorted by (split, line)) then rng.choice(W rows sorted by (split, line)). Repeat subset = random.Random(20261071).sample(sorted formal keys, 20). Key = SNLIPairId. v0.6: screen H and selected S/W with ATTRIBUTE_WORDS/PERSON_WORDS; a's frozen sensitive_decisions.json decides hits. Replace excluded pairs in original slot order from the remaining original shuffled pool, skipping taken images; replacement choices use random.Random(SNLIPairId). All retained items and selections stay unchanged; replacements inherit use/order/repeat positions; undecided hits stop before writing. v0.7: continue after all v0.6 replacements; select 120 further formal pairs as block B, using random.Random(SNLIPairId) for updates; original formal pairs are block A; local configs use A+B, codex uses A; repeat subset unchanged.
